description: This file provides utility functions for managing storage of session data and prescriptions using local storage in a client-side web application. It includes functions to load, save, and add prescriptions or session data, utilizing JSON serialization and deserialization with error handling.

methods.name: function safeParse<T>(raw: string | null, fallback: T): T { safeParse
methods.description: Safely parses a JSON string into an object of type T, returning a fallback value if parsing fails or input is null.

methods.name: export function loadSession(): Session | null { loadSession
methods.description: Loads the session data from local storage, returning null if not found or invalid.

methods.name: export function saveSession(session: Session | null): void { saveSession
methods.description: Saves or clears the session data in local storage.

methods.name: export function loadPrescriptions(): SignedPrescription[] { loadPrescriptions
methods.description: Loads the list of prescriptions from local storage, returning an empty array if none found.

methods.name: export function savePrescriptions(list: SignedPrescription[]): void { savePrescriptions
methods.description: Saves the list of prescriptions to local storage.

methods.name: export function addPrescription(p: SignedPrescription): void { addPrescription
methods.description: Adds a new prescription to the stored list by prepending it.
